title.en: Tokens: how a model sees the world

subtitle.zh: 一句话进了模型，先被切碎再被计算。切法不是随机的——它由一套算法决定，并悄悄决定了你的成本、上限，和模型的大部分「怪癖」。
subtitle.en: A sentence is chopped into tokens before a model reads it — and the chopping is algorithmic, quietly deciding your cost, your limits, and most of the model's quirks.

h.zh: 从现象到机制：模型到底读到了什么

p.zh: 你输入「人工智能」，模型看到的不是 4 个汉字，也不是 1 个词，而是几个 token。Token 是训练前就用 BPE（Byte Pair Encoding，字节对编码）算法从海量文本里统计出来的高频碎片：算法从单个字符开始，反复把「最常一起出现的相邻片段」合并成新条目，直到词表被填满（通常 5 万～20 万条）。
p.en: Type 人工智能 and the model doesn't see 4 characters or 1 word but several tokens. Tokens are frequent fragments mined by BPE (Byte Pair Encoding) before training: starting from single bytes, the algorithm repeatedly merges the most frequent adjacent pair into a new entry until the vocabulary (usually 50k–200k entries) is full.

deep.zh: 为什么是这个算法？因为它是对「压缩」的贪心逼近：词表条目越能覆盖高频片段，同样一句话需要的 token 数越少，训练和推理的序列就越短、越便宜。所以词表不是语言学产物，是压缩经济学产物——英语语料占了大头，英语最「省钱」，中文里不常见的组合就碎。
deep.en: Why this algorithm? It is greedy compression: entries that cover frequent fragments shorten every sequence, making training and inference cheaper. A vocabulary is an artifact of compression economics, not linguistics — English dominates the corpus and stays cheap; rarer combinations fragment.

h.zh: 算一笔账：token 如何变成钱和时间
h.en: The math: how tokens become money and latency

p.zh: 三件事都按 token 记账。计价：主流模型按「每百万 token」报价，输入通常比输出便宜 3～5 倍。上限：上下文窗口（模型一次能处理的总量）也按 token 计，你的提问、贴进来的文档、历史对话、回复，全部挤占同一个窗口。速度：生成是逐 token 进行的，回复快慢直接正比于输出 token 数。
p.en: Three things are billed in tokens. Pricing: mainstream models quote per million tokens, with input usually 3–5x cheaper than output. Limits: the context window — everything you type, paste, and the whole conversation plus the reply — shares one token budget. Latency: generation proceeds token by token, so speed tracks output length.

p.zh: 把一份 8000 字的合同贴给模型问问题：中文按 1 字 ≈ 1～1.5 token 算，这份合同 ≈ 1 万 token，还没提问就吃掉约 1 万 token 输入。若输入价 $1/百万 token，单次成本约 $0.01——便宜，但如果这段对话要重复 20 轮，且每轮都重复贴合同，成本和窗口占用就放大 20 倍。省法子：把合同摘要成 500 字再贴，token 降为约 1/20。
p.en: Paste an 8,000-character contract into a chat: at roughly 1–1.5 tokens per Chinese character it is ≈10k tokens of input before you even ask. At $1/M input tokens that is about $0.01 per call — trivial, until the same contract rides along for 20 turns, multiplying cost and window usage 20x. Fix: summarize to 500 characters first; tokens drop to 1/20.

h.zh: 怪癖的根源：模型看到的不是你以为的
h.en: Why quirks happen: the model sees something else

p.zh: 让模型数「strawberry 里有几个 r」，它常答错——不是它笨，是它看到的根本不是 s-t-r-a-w-b-e-r-r-y 这个字母序列，而是类似「str」「aw」「berry」的 token 序列。每个 token 对它是一个不可再分的编号，字母信息只在编号背后隐约存在，所以它必须「猜」每个块里有几个字母。
p.en: Ask a model how many r's are in strawberry and it may fail — not because it is dumb, but because it never sees s-t-r-a-w-b-e-r-r-y. It sees tokens like str / aw / berry, atomic IDs whose letters are only faintly implied, so it must guess what hides inside each chunk.

p.zh: 「模型认识单词」。对模型来说没有单词，只有 token 编号序列。同理，「模型知道自己的字数上限」也不成立——它感知不到 token 边界，超限会被硬截断，而不是礼貌地告诉你。写长文时主动分段、主动要求「先列大纲再逐段写」，本质都是在帮它管理 token。
p.en: “The model knows words.” It doesn't — only token-ID sequences. Likewise it cannot feel its own length limit: overflow is hard truncation, not a polite warning. Asking for an outline first, then section by section, is really token management on its behalf.

h.zh: 延伸：这个知识点连向哪里

p.zh: Token 是后面几乎所有主题的地基：第 3 天的「温度与采样」发生在每个 token 的选择上；第 4 天的「上下文窗口」是 token 预算的分配问题；阶段二的「上下文工程」本质是 token 的经济学；阶段三 Agent 的工具调用输出也是一串 token。今天只需带走一句话——
p.en: Tokens underpin everything ahead: sampling (day 3) happens per token; the context window (day 4) is a token budget; context engineering (stage 2) is token economics; agent tool calls (stage 3) are also token streams. For today, one sentence is enough —

p.zh: 打开 tokenizer 演示页（搜 “OpenAI tokenizer”），依次输入三组内容并记录 token 数：① 「人工智能」vs「artificial intelligence」；② 你的名字；③ 一段 100 字的自我介绍。然后用一句话回答：为什么第 ③ 组的平均「每词 token 数」比第 ① 组高？（提示：词表里谁的语料多）
p.en: Open a tokenizer demo (search “OpenAI tokenizer”) and record token counts for: (1) 人工智能 vs artificial intelligence; (2) your name; (3) a 100-character self-intro. Then answer in one sentence: why is the tokens-per-word ratio higher in (3) than (1)? (Hint: whose corpus filled the vocabulary?)

takeaway.zh: Token 是模型的记账单位，也是压缩的产物：成本、窗口、速度、怪癖，全都从「切法」来。
takeaway.en: Tokens are the model's unit of account — and an artifact of compression: cost, windows, speed and quirks all follow from the cut.

hook.en: How many tokens is this sentence?

sentence.zh: 先把事看清，再把话说清。
sentence.en: Understand it first. Then explain it plainly.

coverHook.zh: 同样的 12 个字，中文 10 个 token，英文 11 个——账单不一样。
coverHook.en: Same 12 characters: 10 tokens in Chinese, 11 in English — and different bills.
